title: LiveMem: Maintaining Memory State Continuity in Long-Running LLM Inference
summary: LiveMem: Maintaining Memory State Continuity in Long-Running LLM Inference｜Long-running assistants and agents consume interaction streams that eventually outgrow the context. Exist

extra.description: Long-running assistants and agents consume interaction streams that eventually outgrow the context. Existing context retention, summarization, and retrieval preserve access to selected history, but do not provide a persistent state over the full lifecycle when working context changes.
